ROOM_SOUNDPROOF bit 5 blocks the channel at the sender before any peer bytes.

At COLOR_LEV C_CMP the speaker's echo carries com_msgs[subcmd][3] with KNRM folded into the sprintf before act's newline; keep-ansi proves KYEL for holler/shout/gossip/newbie and KMAG for auction, byte for byte (R1/R5h).

At COLOR_LEV C_NRM each listener line is send_to_char(color_on) / act() / send_to_char(KNRM), so the reset follows the whole line; the peer's raw bytes carry KYEL/KMAG/KGRN with the reset after the line ending (R1/R3/R5h).
At COLOR_LEV C_OFF the speaker's echo is the plain sprintf branch with no color byte for any of the six channels, even though every com_msgs entry has one (R4/R5h).
At COLOR_LEV C_OFF the listener receives no color_on and no KNRM for any channel; keep-ansi certifies the port invents no escape (R4/R5h).
At COLOR_LEV C_NRM=2 the speaker's echo stays plain because the echo needs C_CMP=3; this is the sender half of the two-threshold gate (R1/R5h).
At COLOR_LEV C_NRM=2 the listener line is still colored because a listener needs only C_NRM; together with the echo row this pins both thresholds (R1/R5h).

The NPC-authored SCMD_GOSSIP descriptor loop (quan_lo) has no self echo but wraps each listener with the gossip KYEL at COLOR_LEV C_NRM and a KNRM after the whole line, matching a player author (R1/R5c).
